title: S01 Wall Cupboard
description: Original shallow 0.6m wide,0.32m deep,0.7m high wall cupboard with a true storage cavity, internal shelf and two rear mounting cleats. Same-family painted casework and small dark handle. Concept lower edge1.45m above the floor with a0.9m countertop proxy is a game-visual layout convention, not an installation specification. Editable fixed cupboard components; no door-motion or load-rating claim. Rear cleat faces define the wall mounting interface; local lower edge is a placement datum, not floor support. Hidden-front cavity image is a diagnostic only.
